_comment: Map 3: downtown Hays, Kansas in the 1990s (levels 13-20). Same schema, same streets and same shop cell as hays.json (Map 1, the 1970s); only the zoning has moved on. build.mjs INLINES this as MAPS[3] - never fetched at runtime (CSP, file:// CORS). Edit here, then run: node build.mjs
_changes: [INVENTED] Against the 1980s map: student housing for Fort Hays State at 11th & Walnut (1,1) and 5th & Ash (6,2), a strip centre on 8th & Ash (4,2), and storefronts down Oak at 6th (5,5). Rail, parks, civic and the shop never move.
